title: Design System: Sails P2P Trading SDK — Reference UI

display.purpose: Wordmark and page headlines only — the one place carrying brand personality.

body.purpose: Everything else — dense, platform-native, optimized for legibility over character.

motion.name: color-transition
motion.purpose: Default state-change easing for backgrounds, borders, and text color across the system.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default call-to-action button — orange fill, white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; background: #c2410c; color: #ffffff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(194, 65, 12, 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c2410c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action — transparent fill, hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #0a0a0a; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid #878787; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #f5f5f5; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard container — flat, one surface step above the page, hairline border, no shadow.

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field — filled (Elevated step), hairline border, orange border on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #f5f5f5; border: 1px solid #878787; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; color: #0a0a0a; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #646464; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #c2410c; }

components.name: Status Badge — Buy/Sell
components.description: Semantic status pill — low-opacity tint fill, matching-color hairline border, -500-weight text (the -700 weight this used before failed WCAG AA in dark mode).
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-badge--buy { background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.25); color: #22c55e; } .ds-badge--sell { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25); color: #ef4444; }

narrative.overview: sails-ui is meant to feel like a wallet app people already know how to use — Binance P2P, Airtm, El Dorado — not like a novel design experiment. That familiarity is the point: an integrator plugs the SDK in and inherits an interface their own users won't have to learn. Density reads as competence, not clutter — this is a trading surface first, a brand showcase second. Branding is quiet and consistent (black + orange, orange used sparingly) rather than loud. The system explicitly rejects two things already ruled out in this project's own build history: the generic, overly-rounded 'AI-generated app' look, and decoration that competes with the data it sits next to.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained and confident, not tactile/playful — trading-floor density, not consumer-wallet warmth
One accent color (burnt orange), used rarely and with intent
Flat by default — depth from a three-step neutral surface ladder and hairline borders, never shadows
Sharper corners than the generic AI-app default — a deliberate, already-made decision

rules.name: The Rare Accent Rule
rules.body: Orange is a signal, not a background. It marks the one primary action or the one thing currently true — never a large fill, never a page background, never used twice in the same view for two different meanings.

rules.name: The Two-Orange Rule
rules.body: There are two oranges: the darker, contrast-locked #c2410c for anything with white text on top of it, and the brighter #f97316 only for text/icon-on-surface in dark mode. Never swap them.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No shadows, ever. Depth is a background step and a border, not a blur.

rules.name: The Sharper-Than-Default Rule
rules.body: When in doubt, use less radius, not more. A bubbly, uniformly-rounded interface is the specific look this system was built to avoid.

dos: Do keep orange rare — one primary action or one true state per view
Do use rounded-lg/rounded-md consistently; never introduce a larger radius
Do convey depth with the bg → surface → elevated ladder and a hairline border, never a shadow
Do keep both themes fully specified and symmetric
Do use the -500 weight for semantic status colors in this dark-mode-default app
donts: Don't use the bright dark-mode-only orange as a button fill or as text on a light surface
Don't reach for a card-grid layout for list-like data — follow the hairline-divided list precedent
